top_signals.title: Data Center Expansion Tests Voter Patience
top_signals.summary: The rapid expansion of AI data centers is becoming a political issue in Ohio as residents raise concerns about higher electricity bills, tax incentives and secrecy around local development deals. Representative Greg Landsman joins Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the issue with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ray Dalio says to buy ‘a bit’ of Bitcoin amid potential debt crisis
top_signals.summary: The hedge fund founder with an estimated net worth of $15 billion recommended that investors overweight Bitcoin and gold rather than bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Lawmakers call for investigation into impact of CISA staffing cuts
top_signals.summary: Lawmakers say little is known about how recent cuts have impacted CISA and how the knowledge that was lost has been replaced.
